messages.subject: Executive CV | Global ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Krishnan,

I am reaching out after reviewing COREcruitment's Executive Search and NED & C-Suite work, including your international focus across Europe, the Middle East and South America.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My scope spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, social performance, compliance, strategic partnerships and executive communications across a large-scale mining operation.

Across 12+ years in mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have progressed into director-level leadership and am pursuing international Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Leadership, Chief of Staff and VP-track mandates across natural resources, energy, infrastructure and other regulated industries. I am open to relocation, expatriate and rotational assignments.

I have attached my current three-page executive CV for your consideration. I would welcome a discussion regarding current or upcoming mandates where my background aligns, particularly across the Middle East, Europe, South America and wider international markets.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
